contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Return zero if items is zero. Otherwise return items minus (ceil(items / pageSize) - 1) * pageSize. A full final page contains pageSize items, not zero.
contract.domain: Items is an integer from 0 through 10000; pageSize is an integer from 1 through 1000. Inputs are unchanged.
contract.outputRole: items on last occupied page, or zero for no items
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.

documentation: Native semantics reviewed against VeraCompiler.ets and VeraUi.ets. These tasks are not translated upstream symbols.
